content:
令 \(x=\tan\theta\)，则当 \(x:0\to+\infty\) 时，\(\theta:0\to\frac{\pi}{2}\)，且

\[
\mathrm dx=\sec^2\theta\,\mathrm d\theta.
\]

原积分为

\[
I=\int_0^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm dx}{(1+x^2)(1+x^4)}
=\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{\sec^2\theta\,\mathrm d\theta}{\sec^2\theta(1+\tan^4\theta)}
=\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{\mathrm d\theta}{1+\tan^4\theta}.
\]

再利用对称性 \(\tan(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta)=\cot\theta\)，有

\[
I=\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{\mathrm d\theta}{1+\cot^4\theta}.
\]

两式相加：

\[
2I=\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}
\left(
\frac{1}{1+\tan^4\theta}
+
\frac{1}{1+\cot^4\theta}
\right)\mathrm d\theta.
\]

而

\[
\frac{1}{1+\tan^4\theta}
+
\frac{1}{1+\cot^4\theta}
=
\frac{1}{1+\tan^4\theta}
+
\frac{\tan^4\theta}{1+\tan^4\theta}
=1.
\]

所以

\[
2I=\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}1\,\mathrm d\theta=\frac{\pi}{2},
\]

因此

\[
I=\frac{\pi}{4}.
\]

答案：B
